aggregate_basis: Modeled ratio for recorded work only; incomplete coverage is not an account-wide total.
basis: Authored-work monthly HEH divided by two assumed human-direction hours per elapsed day

direction_calibration.allocation_method: two hours per elapsed calendar day; independent of contribution volume

framework.author: Dr. Mark Allen / HeroForge.AI
framework.formula: AP = modeled HEH / assumed human direction hours
framework.name: The Agentic Power Framework

methodology.acceptance: Only merged public PRs enter public HEH; owned commits must be authored and present on the default branch. Merge-month acceptance counts are separate from work-month HEH.
methodology.attribution: Estimate each accepted PR once; allocate its HEH across UTC authored months in proportion to its attributed non-merge commit counts, preserving every modeled cent. Use the PR creation month only when attributed commit timing is unavailable, and flag that proxy explicitly.
methodology.coverage: A public-only credential refreshes public owned work and retains dated private receipts. Coverage is evaluated per month. Missing private coverage is not evidence of zero private work.
methodology.deduplication: PRs are ordered by acceptance time, repository and number. An implementation commit is credited to the first accepted PR containing it; later PR estimates are reduced in proportion to their newly credited implementation commits, with no separate integration-effort credit. Owned commits are deduplicated by one-way SHA-256 digest and excluded if already covered by public PR work.
methodology.direction: User-provided assumption: approximately 14 hours/week, implemented as 2 hours/day. Full months use their actual calendar length; current month uses elapsed UTC dates inclusive.
methodology.heh: PR task-equivalence uses title category and change statistics; owned commits use a fixed conventional-title class. These are effort scenarios, not measured hours, time saved, or downstream value.
methodology.privacy: Private names, URLs, code, raw SHAs, exact dates and commit text are not published. Opaque commit digests permit later public/private overlap checks without publishing private identities.
methodology.range: Low/high curves vary HEH assumptions only, keeping direction at 2h/day. They are sensitivity scenarios, not confidence intervals.
methodology.revision: Later acceptance backfills the authored work month(s), even across the rolling boundary. New activity never reallocates another month's denominator. Current month is partial; evidence/model corrections may revise affected history.

public_prs_excluded_as_reused_implementa.reason: all identifiable implementation commits already credited to an earlier accepted PR

scope: Accepted public upstream PRs plus attributed default-branch commits in accessible personally owned non-fork repositories
